accelerator.kernel_launch_overhead_cycle.source: Standalone vector launch, instruction dispatch and pipeline startup have not been separately characterized for this build.

accelerator.spmm_row_cycles.source: Sparse-row control is not characterized; the recorded hardware disables the sparse matrix unit.

soc.bank_switch_cycles.source: Scratchpad read round-trip delay used when a request stream switches banks.

accelerator.sa_output_pipeline.source: Stage storage comes from synthesized RTL; delays come from unstalled RTL handshakes. Writeback restart covers loop drain and next-command setup, ending at its first input; writeback forward ends at final-output enqueue. Store delays end at the first output beat; remaining beats follow payload width. Start and done delays cover command handshakes.

accelerator.sa_input_pipeline.source: Unstalled RTL intervals: final parameter word to controller parameters; controller parameters to first input/weight request; last fill response to the first local-buffer output; array input to deskewed partial sum beyond geometric propagation; and partial sum to final-output enqueue. Payload, parameter word count, array dimensions and waits are calculated in code. Buffer-read intervals run from a local read request to the corresponding array-input handshake, without backpressure.

metadata.scope: Dense single-bank accumulation with performance counters enabled, direct INT24 stores and riding BF16 vector tails without fetched operands. The target identifies the characterized build. The compiler derives payloads, local-buffer reuse, slot placement and stalls from hardware configuration and mapping loops; bank reservations and array propagation remain architectural approximations.
